card.line: The Brook of Egypt was a watercourse that marked the far southwestern edge of the land God gave Israel, near the Great Sea.

moments.title: Southern border of Judah
moments.text: Judah's southern border ran to Azmon, joined the Brook of Egypt, and ended at the Sea.

moments.title: Solomon's great feast
moments.text: A great assembly from Lebo-hamath to the Brook of Egypt joined Solomon to keep the feast before the LORD. Then they went home joyful and glad.

moments.title: Babylon takes Egypt's land
moments.text: The king of Egypt did not march out of his land again, because the king of Babylon had taken all his territory, from the Brook of Egypt to the Euphrates River.

moments.title: Gathered in that day
moments.text: Isaiah says that in that day the LORD will thresh from the Euphrates to the Wadi of Egypt, and the Israelites will be gathered one by one.
